Purpose: Machine-readable qualification gates of a coupon's response matrices against its graded_v2 reference (supervisor decision 48 and the 2026-09-20 gate confirmation): the class statements of the geometry-independence suite's physics table, evaluated on the free view. Changing a threshold means editing this frozen file; every qualification record carries its SHA-256.
FreeView: every source of the reference that is not a contract ZeroTraceIndices knot (PEC-constrained library knots whose 3D coupon energies are nonzero) and whose reference and run diagonal domain energies are nonzero
RelativeOffset: (run - reference) / |reference| of the per-source diagonal quantities: E = Q_ii (domain), p_X = Q_total_ii(X) / E_ii for the interfaces MA / MS / SA
InterfaceTypes: the interface index -> type map is read from the run config's Boundaries.Postprocessing.Dielectric entries (Index, Type), never assumed; a participation p_X sums the whole-interface diagonal energies of every postprocessed interface of type X (a multi-slot coupon postprocesses one interface per slot and type)
ReferenceAnchor: the reference's own Solver.Order (recorded per case as 'vs p<order> anchor'); the reference is a discretization anchor, not a converged limit

SourceClasses.Rule: classify_sources.py geometric classes from the trace apexes and the plan-view boundary (never a hand list); the two thresholds below decide wide vs narrow and near-junction, hence the E gate's scope, and are frozen here with the gates
SourceClasses.NarrowHatWidth: a hat narrower than NarrowHatWidthMicrons (distance from the apex to the nearest apex on the same z level) is a narrow hat, never a wide-class source
SourceClasses.JunctionReach: a source closer than JunctionReachMicrons to a metal-edge / cut junction is a junction-class source, never a wide-class source

E.Statement: every source of the wide classes within 1% of the reference domain energy
E.Report: the all-free within-1% count and the worst free source

p_MA.Statement: free signed median within 1%, reference-p_MA-weighted mean within 1%, every strongest-reference-MA source within 2%, every free source within 5%
p_MA.QuantityRule: user decision 60(1) / supervisor decision 61a: the MA statements are evaluated on the sharp-edge extrapolated participation p_MA_sharp = (MA_raw + MA_tail) / E of the run (ma_tail.py: MA_raw the sum of the per-ring MA shells, MA_tail the `Consistent` estimator - the top edge's -2/3 law anchored on ring 2 with the ring-1 factor measured on this run, the bottom edge's own rings-2..4 law) against the reference's sharp-edge p_MA: extrapolated by the same rule when its ring / edge sizing is recorded, else modelled from its edge size via the eps^(1/3) law and annotated 'reference unextrapolated' (raw-vs-raw is recorded next to it); a run without radial shells is gated on the raw p_MA and says so
p_MA.StrongestRule: the 20 strongest reference-MA free sources, or every free source when fewer than 20

p_MS.Statement: free |median| within 1%, every free source within 5%

p_SA.Statement: at least 2/3 of the free sources within 2% and at least 90% within 5% (the EL4c level: 40 / 56 of 60)

PSequenceControls.Statement: for every control source the p-step d45 = (p_high - p_main) / |p_high| of the domain energy is within 1% and that of every participation p_MA_sharp / p_MS / p_SA within 5% (controls at the orders below and above the main order); a participation whose control amplitude lies below the amplitude floor is recorded BelowAmplitudeFloor and not judged; a Type with no judged control is recorded UnjudgedTypes and the verdict is PendingQualification (decisions 472 (c) / 474)
PSequenceControls.MAObservableRule: decision 61a: the p-sequence gate on the MA evaluates the sharp-edge extrapolated p_MA_sharp (the tail measured at each order from that order's own shells) in place of the raw p_MA, whose step is dominated by the innermost ring's resolution; the raw p_MA step is still recorded

AmplitudeFloor.Rule: decisions 472 (c) / 474 (control-amplitude-floor PLAN, 2026-10-07): a control's participation p_X is judged only when its Type response can matter. With Q_X the coupon's whole-interface response matrix of the Type at the gated main order (PSD) and a device trace normalised by the excitation potential (|c_i| <= 1, the maximum principle), Cauchy-Schwarz bounds source i's whole contribution to the Type energy of ANY normalised trace by |dE_X| <= 2 sqrt(Q_X,ii E_X(c)) + Q_X,ii, i.e. relative to any trace whose Type energy reaches the coupon's largest Type diagonal Q_max,X = max_j Q_X,jj by (1 + sqrt(Q_X,ii / Q_max,X))^2 - 1. Requiring that to be <= Fraction gives the floor F_X = (sqrt(1 + Fraction) - 1)^2 x Q_max,X (gates.amplitude_floor_ratio: 2.4988e-7 of Q_max,X at Fraction 1e-3; the absolute contribution is <= Fraction x Q_max,X for every normalised trace). The control's amplitude is the larger of its main- and high-order numerators Q_X,ii; Q_max,X is read from every source of the gated main stage (p_MA_sharp: the sharp quantity Q_MA + tail). Below the floor the observable is recorded BelowAmplitudeFloor (amplitude, floor, maximum, ratio, the step it would have been judged on) and neither passes nor fails; E (domain) is always judged. Fraction 1e-3 = 1/50 of the participation step bound and of the D4 bar, 1/10 of the E step bound; the energy ratio 2.5e-7 is below the accepted partition-reproducibility floor of the near-edge interface entries (<= 8e-6 of the interface's largest entry, decisions 466 / 468). The ratio is derived from Fraction, never written as a case constant; it is invariant under rigid transforms of the coupon and under any common energy scale.
AmplitudeFloor.UnjudgedTypes: a gated Type with no judged control (every control below its floor) is recorded UnjudgedTypes; the verdict is PendingQualification (never Passed / Qualified, never Failed on that account) until a controls-only re-qualification with amplitude-informed controls (classify_sources.choose_controls with the stored p4 amplitudes) judges it (decision 474)
AmplitudeFloor.Information: per Type the coupon sources below the floor and the bound (1 + sum_i sqrt(Q_ii / Q_max))^2 - 1 on their collective contribution (BelowFloorAggregate); per class the members above the floor for every judged Type (AboveFloorMembers): recorded, never gated

LibraryContinuity.Statement: every pair / stack model whose consecutive edge separations are all at or above 2R (1 - ThresholdBandOverR) responds per basis function like the isolated-edge model within MaximumRelativeOffset (decision 82(4): the strict interaction rule at 2R is continuous only if the pair model at the threshold equals two isolated edges; USER decision 117(3), 2026-09-28: compared per basis function; USER decision 2026-09-28 on the decision-117 review MAJOR-2: gated per edge in aggregate AND per matched basis function against PerBasisFunctionLimit, an edge with zero matched basis functions Failed)
LibraryContinuity.Quantity: per edge: the energy-weighted per-basis-function offset (sum of the diagonal domain-response entries Q_ii of the basis functions assigned to the edge over the sum of the isolated-edge model's Q_ii at the same positions in the edge's local frame, minus one), each candidate basis function matched to the isolated basis function within MatchToleranceOverSpacing x the isolated hat spacing; basis functions within CornerExclusionOverR x R of a corner of the isolated coupon's box are not compared (the box truncation changes their support); unmatched basis functions are reported, never gated; the per-hat offsets (median, worst) are recorded (library_continuity.py); per matched basis function: its own offset (candidate Q_ii over its isolated partner's Q_ii, minus one) against PerBasisFunctionLimit, the verdict failing on any matched hat above it; an edge with zero matched basis functions is Failed (not NotApplicable)
LibraryContinuity.PreviousQuantity: until decision 117(3): per edge, the sum of Q_ii of the basis points nearest to the edge line divided by the edge length: a hat-count artefact (-23 / -51 / -24 % at the 1.985 R threshold stack whose per-hat response agrees within 1 %); evaluated and recorded as PreviousDefinition, not gated
LibraryContinuity.PerBasisFunctionLimitRule: USER decision 2026-09-28 (decision-117 review MAJOR-2): every matched basis function's own offset must lie within this limit (the recorded threshold stack / pair pass with worst hats -1.8 / -2.3 / -1.6 % and -1.3 %); a single hat carries the mesh noise of two independently meshed coupons (+-1-2 %), so the per-hat limit is looser than the 1 % energy-weighted aggregate, which stays the per-edge gate
LibraryContinuity.Scope: runs on the written process-library.json of every qualify run (NotApplicable without a pair / stack at the threshold or without an isolated-edge model); synthetic library data tests in test_library_continuity.py

CornerFamilyInterpolation.Statement: every held-out coupon of an angle-interpolated corner family (USER decision 121 (C)) is reproduced by the segment stencil of the family's nodes within MaximumParticipationReferencedResidual on the held-out trace energy of every fabricated interface response matrix SA / MS / MA, the residual referred to the held-out coupon's own fabricated energy of that interface (participation-referenced: USER decision 149 (5), 2026-09-29); the defect-referenced residuals are reported alongside, never gated
CornerFamilyInterpolation.Quantity: per held-out coupon and interface X in SA / MS / MA: (c^T Q_X,fab,interpolated c - c^T Q_X,fab c) / (c^T Q_X,fab c) with c the held-out coupon's held-out trace coefficients (heldout-coefficients.csv), Q_X,fab its fabricated surface response matrix (surface-response-matrix-aggregate.csv) and the interpolated matrix the Lagrange combination of the segment's node matrices (SelectCornerFamilyStencil / corner_family_interpolation.select_stencil: the stencil never straddles a knot-corner passage); the same residual for the domain matrix is recorded; a held-out angle the stencil rule refuses (outside the node range, legacy family) is a failure of the check, not a pass

ReportedAlongside.DefectReferenced: (c^T D_interpolated c - c^T D c) / (c^T D c) for the defects D = Q_fab - Q_thin of the domain and of every interface: the residual relative to the correction itself (the corner-family block's form; 1-10 % of the participation, so its residual is 10-100 x the participation error and sits at the per-angle-mesh noise floor)
ReportedAlongside.CorrectedParticipation: (c^T D_interpolated c - c^T D c) / (c^T Q_X,fab c): the error of the corrected participation of interface X in the participation-referenced units

CornerFamilyInterpolation.Rule: USER decision 149 (5): the family is gated on the participation-referenced residual because the device quotes participations, not corrections (the recorded qualified family: worst 0.28 % (convex MA at 127.5 deg) against defect-referenced worst 3.0 %); a family whose nodes carry no segment connectivity records is never interpolated by the runtime and has no held-out verdict
CornerFamilyInterpolation.Scope: corner_coupon/corner_family_heldout_check.py on the coupon cache directories of one family (nodes = the coupons with TraceBasis.ConnectivityAngleDegrees, or the --nodes ANGLE:CONNECTIVITY list for recorded legacy coupons stamped into a segment, or the --nodes ANGLE list of an AllRingsFollowMetal family (corner-basis refinement 2026-09-30: no events, one segment); every other coupon is held out); the verdict is recorded next to the family's library (corner-qualification-20260929, user-decisions-149-20260929); synthetic family tests in test_corner_family_heldout_check.py
CornerFamilyInterpolation.GatingTraceRule: USER decision 161 (2), 2026-09-30: the option-(c) held-out traces GATE the family (the coefficients of generate_corner_response.heldout_potential at the nodes' basis points: zero on the PEC part of the box only, every free knot excited); the band-trace verdict (the pre-149 (6) metal-band cutoff, blind to the free knots next to the metal) is reported alongside, never gated. corner_family_heldout_check.py records the trace it used (TraceSource / TraceForms) and whether it is the gating trace (Gating); only a run on the gating trace is the family's verdict

Verdicts.Passed: every gate with a reference passed and every p-sequence control passed
Verdicts.Failed: a gate or a p-sequence control failed on a complete run (with or without a reference)
Verdicts.PendingQualification: no reference matrices for this coupon and every p-sequence control passed: the matrices carry their own convergence control but no accuracy statement; never Passed; or every gate passed but a Type's p-sequence has no judged control (UnjudgedTypes; decision 474)
